u5-l1.co-potrebujeme-na.en.en: What do we need for the party?

u5-l1.co-potrebujeme-na.note.en: Emma and Lucia are planning a party (oslava). potrebovať = to need: potrebuj**em**, potrebuj**eš**, potrebuj**e**…
u5-l1.co-potrebujeme-na.note.t: Emma va Lusiya bazm (oslava) rejalashtiryapti. potrebovať = kerak boʻlmoq: potrebuj**em**, potrebuj**eš**, potrebuj**e**…

en: “We” is **my**, so potrebovať takes the my ending **-me**: **potrebujeme**. Potrebujem is the ja form, I need.
t: «Biz» — **my**, shuning uchun potrebovať **-me** qoʻshimchasini oladi: **potrebujeme** (bizga kerak). Potrebujem — ja shakli, «menga kerak».

u5-l1.kava-a-mineralka.note.en: minerálka is short for minerálna voda.
u5-l1.kava-a-mineralka.note.t: minerálka — minerálna voda (mineral suv) soʻzining qisqa shakli.

u5-l1.kolko-stoji-sunka.note.en: You know **stáť** from unit 4: Šunka stojí tri eurá. = The ham costs three euros.
u5-l1.kolko-stoji-sunka.note.t: **stáť** sizga 4-boʻlimdan tanish: Šunka stojí tri eurá. = Vetchina uch yevro turadi.

u5-l1.fill-kolko-stoji-kava.why.en: Káva is one thing, so stáť takes the one-thing form: **stojí**. Stoja is for two or more things, stojím for ja.
u5-l1.fill-kolko-stoji-kava.why.t: Káva — bitta narsa, shuning uchun stáť bitta narsa shaklida keladi: **stojí**. Stoja ikki va undan ortiq narsa uchun, stojím esa ja uchun.

en: Káva is one thing, so stáť takes the one-thing form **stojí**, even though tri eurá is plural. Stoja is for two or more things.
After 2, 3 and 4, use the plural: neuter euro becomes **eurá**, so tri **eurá**. Euro is for just one: jedno euro.
t: Káva — bitta narsa, shuning uchun stáť bitta narsa shaklida keladi: **stojí**, tri eurá koʻplik boʻlsa ham. Stoja ikki va undan ortiq narsa uchun.
2, 3 va 4 dan keyin koʻplik keladi: oʻrta jinsdagi euro **eurá** boʻladi, tri **eurá**. Euro faqat bitta uchun: jedno euro.

u5-l1.kupim-cerstvy-chlieb.note.en: kúpiť = to buy: kúpim, kúpiš, kúpi… It usually points to the future: “I'll buy”. čerstvý = fresh.
u5-l1.kupim-cerstvy-chlieb.note.t: kúpiť = sotib olmoq: kúpim, kúpiš, kúpi… Bu shakl odatda kelajakni bildiradi: «sotib olaman». čerstvý = yangi (ovqat haqida: yangi non; nový esa yangi narsa: yangi telefon).

en: I will buy wine and beer.

u5-l1.fill-mame-syr-ale.en.en: We have cheese, but we don't have butter.
u5-l1.fill-mame-syr-ale.en.t: Bizda pishloq bor, lekin sariyogʻ yoʻq.

u5-l1.fill-mame-syr-ale.why.en: To say not, put **ne-** on the verb as one word: máme → **nemáme**. Nie sme is the not form of byť (we aren't), and nemajú is for oni.
u5-l1.fill-mame-syr-ale.why.t: Inkor uchun feʼlga **ne-** qoʻshib yoziladi: máme → **nemáme**. Nie sme — byť feʼlining inkori («biz … emasmiz»), nemajú esa oni uchun.

u5-l1.speak-co-potrebujeme-na.en.en: What do we need for the party?

en: After verbs like mať, potrebovať, kúpiť and hľadať (to look for), the object goes into the accusative case (akuzatív).
Feminine nouns change -a to **-u**. Masculine things and neuter nouns stay the same.
t: mať, potrebovať, kúpiť va hľadať (qidirmoq) kabi feʼllardan keyin toʻldiruvchi akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) keladi. U oʻzbekcha «kimni? nimani?» savoliga javob beradi.
Ayol jinsidagi otlarda -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi. Erkak jinsidagi narsalar va oʻrta jins otlari oʻzgarmaydi.

u5-l2.fill-potrebujem-kavu.why.en: Coffee is what you need, the object, so it takes the accusative: feminine nouns change -a to **-u**, káva → **kávu**.
u5-l2.fill-potrebujem-kavu.why.t: Qahva — sizga kerak narsa, yaʼni toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) keladi: ayol jinsidagi otlarda -a oʻrniga **-u**, káva → **kávu**.

en: An adjective agrees with its noun. In the accusative, feminine -á becomes **-ú**.
With masculine things and neuter nouns, nothing changes.
t: Sifat oʻz otiga moslashadi. Akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) ayol jinsidagi -á oʻrniga **-ú** keladi.
Erkak jinsidagi narsalar va oʻrta jins otlari bilan hech narsa oʻzgarmaydi.

u5-l2.fill-hladam-cerstvu-sunku.why.en: An adjective agrees with its noun. Šunku is a feminine object, so čerstvá changes -á to **-ú**: **čerstvú**. Čerstvý is the masculine form.
u5-l2.fill-hladam-cerstvu-sunku.why.t: Sifat oʻz otiga moslashadi. Šunku — ayol jinsidagi toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun čerstvá soʻzida -á oʻrniga **-ú** keladi: **čerstvú**. Čerstvý — erkak jinsi shakli.

en: Coffee is what you'll buy, the object, so it takes the accusative: feminine nouns change -a to **-u**, káva → **kávu**.
The speaker is **ja** (I'll buy), so kúpiť takes the ja ending **-m**: **kúpim**. Kúpiš is the ty form.
t: Qahva — siz sotib oladigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) keladi: ayol jinsidagi otlarda -a oʻrniga **-u**, káva → **kávu**.
Gapiruvchi — **ja** (sotib olaman), shuning uchun kúpiť **-m** bilan tugaydi: **kúpim**. Kúpiš — ty shakli.

u5-l2.choice-potrebujeme-mineralku.why.en: After potrebovať, the object goes into the accusative: feminine nouns change -a to **-u**, so minerálka → **minerálku**.
u5-l2.choice-potrebujeme-mineralku.why.t: potrebovať (kerak boʻlmoq) feʼlidan keyin toʻldiruvchi akuzatívda keladi: ayol jinsidagi otlarda -a oʻrniga **-u**, minerálka → **minerálku**.

u5-l2.fill-mame-dobre-vino.why.en: Víno is neuter, and neuter nouns don't change as objects, so the adjective stays **dobré**. Dobrú is for feminine nouns, dobrého for male people.
u5-l2.fill-mame-dobre-vino.why.t: Víno oʻrta jinsda, oʻrta jins otlari esa toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda oʻzgarmaydi, shuning uchun sifat ham **dobré** boʻlib qoladi. Dobrú ayol jinsi, dobrého esa erkak kishilar uchun.

u5-l2.listen-kupim-kavu-a.en.en: I'll buy coffee and fresh bread.
u5-l2.listen-kupim-kavu-a.en.t: Qahva va yangi non sotib olaman.

en: Ask **Koho?** (whom?) about people and **Čo?** (what?) about things.
Masculine nouns for people (and animals) add **-a**, and their adjectives end in **-ého**. Women follow the -u rule: Luci**a** → Luci**u**.
t: Odamlar haqida **Koho?** (kimni?), narsalar haqida **Čo?** (nimani?) deb soʻraladi.
Odamni (va hayvonni) bildiruvchi erkak jinsidagi otlarga **-a** qoʻshiladi, ularning sifatlari esa **-ého** bilan tugaydi. Ayollar -u qoidasiga boʻysunadi: Luci**a** → Luci**u**.

u5-l2.fill-lucia-ma-brata.why.en: A brother is a person and the object of má, so the masculine noun adds **-a**: brat → **brata**. Only masculine things stay the same.
u5-l2.fill-lucia-ma-brata.why.t: Aka — odam va má feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun erkak jinsidagi ot **-a** oladi: brat → **brata**. Faqat erkak jinsidagi narsalar oʻzgarmaydi.

u5-l2.choice-koho-hladas.why.en: **Koho?** (whom?) asks about a person, so the answer names one: Marek → **Mareka**. Syr and kávu are things, which answer **Čo?**
u5-l2.choice-koho-hladas.why.t: **Koho?** (kimni?) odam haqida soʻraydi, shuning uchun javobda odam boʻladi: Marek → **Mareka**. Syr va kávu — narsalar, ular **Čo?** (nimani?) savoliga javob beradi.

u5-l2.build-hladame-tomasa-a.prompt.en: We're looking for Tomáš and Lucia.

en: Tomáš is a person and the object of hľadáme, so the masculine name adds **-a**: **Tomáša**. Only masculine things stay the same.
Lucia is the object of hľadáme, and women follow the feminine rule: -a changes to **-u**, Lucia → **Luciu**.
t: Tomash — odam va qidirilayotgan kishi (oʻzbekchada «Tomashni»), shuning uchun erkak ismi **-a** oladi: **Tomáša**. Faqat erkak jinsidagi narsalar oʻzgarmaydi.
Lusiya — hľadáme feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, ayollar esa ayol jinsi qoidasiga boʻysunadi: -a oʻrniga **-u**, Lucia → **Luciu** (Lusiyani).

u5-l2.fill-mam-noveho-kamarata.why.en: Kamarát is a male person, and as an object his adjective ends in **-ého**: **nového**. Nový is for masculine things, novú for feminine nouns.
u5-l2.fill-mam-noveho-kamarata.why.t: Kamarát — erkak kishi, toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda uning sifati **-ého** bilan tugaydi: **nového**. Nový erkak jinsidagi narsalar, novú esa ayol jinsidagi otlar uchun.

u5-obchod.obchod.note.en: Groceries are sold in **potraviny** (a plural-only word, like noviny), medicine in a **lekáreň** (pharmacy), soap and shampoo in a **drogéria**.
u5-obchod.obchod.note.t: Oziq-ovqat doʻkoni — **potraviny** (noviny kabi faqat koʻplikda keladigan soʻz), dorixona — **lekáreň**, sovun va shampun sotiladigan doʻkon — **drogéria**.

u5-obchod.ovocie-a-zelenina.note.en: Each is one word for many things: **ovocie** (neuter) is all fruit, **zelenina** (feminine) all vegetables.
u5-obchod.ovocie-a-zelenina.note.t: Har biri koʻp narsani bildiradigan bitta soʻz: **ovocie** (oʻrta jins) — barcha mevalar, **zelenina** (ayol jinsi) — barcha sabzavotlar.

u5-obchod.jablko-a-banan.note.en: Also **pomaranč** (orange) and **hruška** (pear). In the plural: jablk**á**, banán**y**, pomaranč**e**, hrušk**y**.
u5-obchod.jablko-a-banan.note.t: Yana: **pomaranč** (apelsin) va **hruška** (nok). Koʻplikda: jablk**á**, banán**y**, pomaranč**e**, hrušk**y**.

u5-obchod.zemiaky-a-cibula.note.t: Bitta kartoshka — **zemiak**, zemiaky esa koʻplik. Yana: **paradajka** (pomidor) va **paprika** (bulgʻor qalampiri).

u5-obchod.build-potrebujem-zemiaky-a.pro.en: I need potatoes and an onion.

en: The onion is what you need, the object, so feminine -a changes to **-u**: cibuľ**u**.
You need more than one potato, so it's the plural: zemiak**y**. Zemiak is one potato.
t: Piyoz — sizga kerak narsa, yaʼni toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun ayol jinsidagi -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: cibuľ**u**.
Oʻzbekchada «kartoshka» koʻplik qoʻshimchasiz ham koʻp narsani bildiradi, slovakchada esa koʻplik kerak: zemiak**y**. Zemiak — bitta kartoshka.

u5-obchod.prosim-si-dve-jablka.note.en: **Prosím si** + the accusative is the polite way to ask for something in a shop or a café: Prosím si kávu.
u5-obchod.prosim-si-dve-jablka.note.t: **Prosím si** + akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) — doʻkon yoki kafeda biror narsa soʻrashning xushmuomala usuli: Prosím si kávu. = Qahva, iltimos.

u5-obchod.fill-prosim-si-cibulu.why.en: Prosím si takes an object, so it's the accusative: feminine -a changes to **-u**, cibuľa → cibuľ**u**.
u5-obchod.fill-prosim-si-cibulu.why.t: Prosím si iborasidan keyin toʻldiruvchi, yaʼni akuzatív keladi: ayol jinsidagi -a oʻrniga **-u**, cibuľa → cibuľ**u**.

u5-obchod.este-nieco.note.en: What the shop assistant asks. If that's all: **Nie, to je všetko.** = No, that's everything.
u5-obchod.este-nieco.note.t: Sotuvchi shunday soʻraydi. Agar boshqa hech narsa kerak boʻlmasa: **Nie, to je všetko.** = Yoʻq, shu hammasi.

u5-obchod.choice-este-nieco.question.en: The shop assistant asks “Ešte niečo?” You have everything you need. What do you say?
u5-obchod.choice-este-nieco.question.t: Sotuvchi «Ešte niečo?» deb soʻraydi. Sizga kerak narsaning hammasi bor. Nima deysiz?

u5-obchod.platim-kartou.note.en: **platiť** = to pay: platím, platíš, platí… In cash: **Platím v hotovosti.** You pay at the **pokladňa** (till).
u5-obchod.platim-kartou.note.t: **platiť** = toʻlamoq: platím, platíš, platí… Naqd pulda: **Platím v hotovosti.** Kassa — **pokladňa**, pul oʻsha yerda toʻlanadi.

u5-l3.cerveny-modry-zeleny.note.en: Colours are adjectives, like nový: červen**é** víno = red wine.
u5-l3.cerveny-modry-zeleny.note.t: Ranglar sifatdir, xuddi nový kabi: červen**é** víno = qizil vino.

u5-l3.biely-cierny-zlty.note.en: biely and čierny have short endings: biel**a**, čiern**a**, and biel**u**, čiern**u** as objects (not -á, -ú). biele víno = white wine.
u5-l3.biely-cierny-zlty.note.t: biely va čierny qisqa qoʻshimchalar oladi: biel**a**, čiern**a**, akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) esa biel**u**, čiern**u** (-á, -ú emas). biele víno = oq vino.

u5-l3.fill-sukna-je-cervena.why.en: An adjective takes the gender of its noun, after je too. Sukňa is feminine, so the colour ends in **-á**: červen**á**. Červený is masculine, červené neuter.
u5-l3.fill-sukna-je-cervena.why.t: Sifat je soʻzidan keyin ham otning jinsiga moslashadi. Sukňa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun rang **-á** bilan tugaydi: červen**á**. Červený — erkak jinsi, červené — oʻrta jins.

u5-l3.chcem-cierne-tricko.note.en: chcieť = to want: chcem, chceš, chce… The colour takes the accusative too: čiern**u** sukň**u**.
u5-l3.chcem-cierne-tricko.note.t: chcieť = xohlamoq: chcem, chceš, chce… Rang ham akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) keladi: čiern**u** sukň**u**.

u5-l3.fill-hladam-ciernu-suknu.en.en: I'm looking for a black skirt.

u5-l3.fill-hladam-ciernu-suknu.why.en: Sukňu is a feminine object, so the colour changes too. Čierny has short endings: čierna → **čiernu**, with -u, not -ú.
u5-l3.fill-hladam-ciernu-suknu.why.t: Sukňu — ayol jinsidagi toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun rang ham oʻzgaradi. Čierny qisqa qoʻshimchalar oladi: čierna → **čiernu**, -ú emas, -u bilan.

en: Košeľu is a feminine object, so the colour changes too. Biely has short endings: biela → **bielu**, with -u, not -ú.
The shirt is what you want, the object of chcem, so feminine košeľa changes -a to **-u**: **košeľu**.
t: Košeľu — ayol jinsidagi toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun rang ham oʻzgaradi. Biely qisqa qoʻshimchalar oladi: biela → **bielu**, -ú emas, -u bilan.
Koʻylak — siz xohlagan narsa, chcem feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun ayol jinsidagi košeľa soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: **košeľu**.

u5-l3.darcek.note.en: Emma and Tomáš are looking for a present for Lucia's party.
u5-l3.darcek.note.t: Emma va Tomash Lusiyaning bazmi uchun sovgʻa qidiryapti.

u5-l3.listen-emma-a-tomas.en.en: Emma and Tomáš are looking for a present.

u5-l3.aku-farbu-mas.en.en: What colour do you like? (to a woman)

u5-l3.aku-farbu-mas.note.en: mať rád (said of a man) / mať rada (of a woman) = to like. Mám rada zelen**ú** farb**u**. = I like green.
u5-l3.aku-farbu-mas.note.t: mať rád (erkak haqida) / mať rada (ayol haqida) = yoqtirmoq. Mám rada zelen**ú** farb**u**. = Men yashil rangni yoqtiraman.

u5-l3.fill-chcem-modry-sveter.why.en: Sveter is a masculine thing, and masculine things don't change as objects, so the colour stays **modrý**. Modrú is for feminine nouns, modrého for male people.
u5-l3.fill-chcem-modry-sveter.why.t: Sveter — erkak jinsidagi narsa, bunday otlar toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda oʻzgarmaydi, shuning uchun rang ham **modrý** boʻlib qoladi. Modrú ayol jinsi, modrého esa erkak kishilar uchun.

u5-l3.build-emma-hlada-zelene.prompt.en: Emma is looking for a green T-shirt.

en: Tričko is neuter, and neuter nouns don't change as objects, so the colour stays **zelené**. Zelenú is for feminine nouns.
Emma is **ona**, so hľadať takes the ona form, with no ending: **hľadá**. Hľadám is the ja form.
t: Tričko oʻrta jinsda, oʻrta jins otlari esa toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda oʻzgarmaydi, shuning uchun rang ham **zelené** boʻlib qoladi. Zelenú ayol jinsidagi otlar uchun.
Emma haqida «u» — **ona**, shuning uchun hľadať ona shaklida, qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **hľadá**. Hľadám — ja shakli.

u5-l3.listen-kolko-stoji-cierny.en.en: How much is the black sweater?

en: Pronouns have object forms too. The short forms go in second place in the sentence, like sa: Mám **ho** rád.
**ho** means both him and it: Sveter? Kúpim **ho**. = The sweater? I'll buy it.
t: Olmoshlarning ham akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) shakllari bor, oʻzbekcha meni, seni, uni kabi. Qisqa shakllar gapda ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi, xuddi sa kabi: Mám **ho** rád.
**ho** — erkak jinsidagi «uni»: odam haqida ham, narsa haqida ham: Sveter? Kúpim **ho**. = Sviter? Uni sotib olaman.

en: Where are you? I'm looking for you.

u5-l4.fill-kde-si-emma.en.en: Where are you, Emma? I'm looking for you.

u5-l4.fill-kde-si-emma.why.en: Emma is ty here, and as an object ty becomes **ťa**: hľadám ťa = I'm looking for you. Ju means her.
u5-l4.fill-kde-si-emma.why.t: Bu yerda Emma — ty (sen), toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda esa ty **ťa** ga aylanadi, xuddi sen → seni kabi: hľadám ťa = seni qidiryapman. Ju — «uni» (ayolni).

en: **pre** (for) takes the accusative: darček pre Luci**u**, pre Tomáš**a**.
After a preposition, pronouns use their long forms.
t: **pre** (uchun) otdan oldin turadi va akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) talab qiladi: darček pre Luci**u** (Lusiya uchun sovgʻa), pre Tomáš**a**. Otdan oldin turadigan bunday soʻzlar predlog deyiladi.
Predlogdan keyin olmoshlarning uzun shakli ishlatiladi.

u5-l4.fill-tomas-mam-ho.why.en: Tomáš is on, and the object form of on is **ho**, in second place: Mám **ho** rada. Ju is her, ich is them.
u5-l4.fill-tomas-mam-ho.why.t: Tomash — on, on soʻzining toʻldiruvchi shakli esa **ho** (uni), u ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: Mám **ho** rada. Ju — «uni» (ayolni), ich — «ularni».

u5-l4.fill-to-je-pre.why.en: After a preposition like **pre**, pronouns use their long forms: pre **teba**. Ťa is the short form, used without a preposition: hľadám ťa.
u5-l4.fill-to-je-pre.why.t: **pre** kabi predlogdan keyin olmoshlarning uzun shakli keladi: pre **teba** (sen uchun). Ťa — qisqa shakl, predlogsiz ishlatiladi: hľadám ťa.

u5-l4.fill-darcek-je-pre.why.en: **Pre** (for) takes the accusative, and Lucia follows the feminine -u rule: Lucia → **Luciu**.
u5-l4.fill-darcek-je-pre.why.t: **Pre** (uchun) akuzatív talab qiladi, Lucia esa ayol jinsidagi -u qoidasiga boʻysunadi: Lucia → **Luciu**.

en: After a preposition like **pre**, pronouns use their long forms: on → pre **neho**. Ho is the short form, used without a preposition.
Him is on, and after **pre** it takes its long form: pre **neho**. Ju means her, and it's a short form, not used after a preposition.
t: **Pre** kabi predlogdan keyin olmoshlarning uzun shakli keladi: on → pre **neho** (u uchun). Ho — qisqa shakl, predlogsiz ishlatiladi.
Bu yerda «u» — erkak, yaʼni on, pre soʻzidan keyin esa uning uzun shakli keladi: pre **neho**. Ju — «uni» (ayolni), qisqa shakl, predlogdan keyin ishlatilmaydi.

en: Some verbs come with **na** + accusative: čakať na (to wait for), pozývať na (to invite to).
Pronouns use the long forms here too: na **teba**, na **neho**, na **ňu**.
t: Baʼzi feʼllar **na** + akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) bilan keladi: čakať na (…ni kutmoq), pozývať na (…ga taklif qilmoq).
Bu yerda ham olmoshlarning uzun shakli ishlatiladi: na **teba**, na **neho**, na **ňu**.

en: I'm inviting you to the party.

u5-l4.fill-cakame-na-tomasa.why.en: **Čakať na** takes the accusative, and masculine nouns for people add **-a**: Tomáš → **Tomáša**.
u5-l4.fill-cakame-na-tomasa.why.t: **Čakať na** (…ni kutmoq) akuzatív talab qiladi, odamni bildiruvchi erkak jinsidagi otlar esa **-a** oladi: Tomáš → **Tomáša** (Tomashni).

u5-l4.choice-cakam-na-teba.why.en: After a preposition like **na**, pronouns use their long forms: na **teba**. Ťa is the short form, used without a preposition, and ty isn't an object form.
u5-l4.choice-cakam-na-teba.why.t: **na** kabi predlogdan keyin olmoshlarning uzun shakli keladi: na **teba**. Ťa — predlogsiz ishlatiladigan qisqa shakl, ty esa toʻldiruvchi shakli emas.

u5-l4.build-pozyvame-ta-na.prompt.en: We're inviting you to the party.

en: **Pozývať na** takes the accusative, so feminine oslava changes -a to **-u**: na **oslavu**.
“We” is **my**, so pozývať takes the my ending **-me**: **pozývame**. Pozývam is the ja form, I'm inviting.
t: «Bazmga» slovakchada **pozývať na** + akuzatív bilan aytiladi: oslava soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi, na **oslavu**.
«Biz» — **my**, shuning uchun pozývať **-me** bilan tugaydi: **pozývame**, oʻzbekchadagi -miz kabi (taklif qilamiz). Pozývam — ja shakli.

u5-l4.listen-pozyvam-ta-na.en.en: I'm inviting you to the party.

en: In the plural, things and women don't change as objects: the accusative is the plural you already know. Kúpim jablká. Mám dve sestry.
Their adjectives keep **-é** too: Kúpim zelené jablká.
t: Koʻplikda narsalar va ayollar toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda oʻzgarmaydi: akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) — siz bilgan koʻplik shaklining oʻzi. Kúpim jablká. Mám dve sestry.
Ularning sifatlari ham **-é** bilan qoladi: Kúpim zelené jablká.

en: I'll buy green apples and bananas.
t: Yashil olma va banan sotib olaman.

u5-mnozne.fill-kupim-tri-banany.why.en: Bananas are things, and things don't change in the plural as objects: tri banán**y**, just as in Tu sú tri banány. Banánov isn't the object form.
u5-mnozne.fill-kupim-tri-banany.why.t: Bananlar — narsalar, narsalar esa koʻplikda toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda oʻzgarmaydi: tri banán**y**, xuddi Tu sú tri banány (Bu yerda uchta banan bor) gapidagi kabi. Banánov toʻldiruvchi shakli emas: -ov faqat erkaklar uchun.

en: Men are different: as objects they end in **-ov**, and their adjectives in **-ých**: Pozývam nov**ých** kamarát**ov**.
Tí becomes **tých**, and 2, 3, 4 become **dvoch**, **troch**, **štyroch**: Mám dv**och** brat**ov**.
t: Erkaklar (va aralash guruh) boshqacha: toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda ular **-ov** bilan, sifatlari esa **-ých** bilan tugaydi: Pozývam nov**ých** kamarát**ov**. = Yangi doʻstlarni taklif qilaman.
Tí oʻrniga **tých**, 2, 3, 4 oʻrniga esa **dvoch**, **troch**, **štyroch** keladi: Mám dv**och** brat**ov**.

en: I'm looking for those new students.

u5-mnozne.fill-na-oslavu-pozyvame.en.en: We're inviting friends to the party.

u5-mnozne.fill-na-oslavu-pozyvame.why.en: The friends are men or a mixed group, and men as objects end in **-ov**: kamarát**ov**. Kamaráti is the subject form, kamaráta just one friend.
u5-mnozne.fill-na-oslavu-pozyvame.why.t: Doʻstlar — erkaklar yoki aralash guruh, toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda esa erkaklar **-ov** bilan tugaydi: kamarát**ov** (doʻstlarni). Kamaráti — ega shakli, kamaráta — bitta doʻst.

u5-mnozne.fill-pan-kovac-ma-dvoch.why.en: Sons are men, and after **dvoch** men take **-ov**: syn**ov**. Synovia is the subject form, syna one son.
u5-mnozne.fill-pan-kovac-ma-dvoch.why.t: Oʻgʻillar — erkaklar, **dvoch** soʻzidan keyin esa erkaklar **-ov** oladi: syn**ov**. Synovia — ega shakli, syna — bitta oʻgʻil.

u5-mnozne.fill-marek-hlada-mladych.en.en: Marek is looking for young cooks.

u5-mnozne.fill-marek-hlada-mladych.why.en: The cooks are men and the object, so their adjective ends in **-ých**: mlad**ých**. Mladí is the subject form, mladé for women and things.
u5-mnozne.fill-marek-hlada-mladych.why.t: Oshpazlar — erkaklar va toʻldiruvchi (oshpazlarni), shuning uchun ularning sifati **-ých** bilan tugaydi: mlad**ých**. Mladí — ega shakli, mladé — ayollar va narsalar uchun.

u5-mnozne.choice-pozyvam-studentov.why.en: As objects, men take **-ov** (študent**ov**), but women keep their plural (študentk**y**). Študenti is the subject form.
u5-mnozne.choice-pozyvam-studentov.why.t: Toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda erkaklar **-ov** oladi (študent**ov**), ayollar esa koʻplik shaklini saqlaydi (študentk**y**). Študenti — ega shakli.

en: The friends are the object, and men's adjectives as objects end in **-ých**: nov**ých**. Noví is the subject form: noví kamaráti.
The friends are the object, and men as objects end in **-ov**: kamarát**ov**. Kamaráti is the subject form.
t: Doʻstlar — toʻldiruvchi (doʻstlarni), toʻldiruvchi boʻlgan erkaklarning sifati esa **-ých** bilan tugaydi: nov**ých**. Noví — ega shakli: noví kamaráti.
Doʻstlar — toʻldiruvchi, oʻzbekchadagi «doʻstlarni» kabi, toʻldiruvchi boʻlgan erkaklar esa **-ov** bilan tugaydi: kamarát**ov**. Kamaráti — ega shakli.

u5-mnozne.listen-lucia-pozyva-kamaratov..t: Lusiya doʻst va dugonalarini taklif qilyapti.

en: I'll buy green apples and tomatoes.
I will buy green apples and tomatoes.
t: Yashil olma va pomidor sotib olaman.
Yashil olmalar va pomidorlar sotib olaman.
Yashil olma va pomidorlar sotib olaman.
Men yashil olma va pomidor sotib olaman.

u5-mam-rad.futbal-a-tenis.note.en: **hrať** = to play: hrám, hráš, hrá… Hráme futbal. = We play football.
u5-mam-rad.futbal-a-tenis.note.t: **hrať** = oʻynamoq: hrám, hráš, hrá… Hráme futbal. = Biz futbol oʻynaymiz.

u5-mam-rad.pocuvat-hudbu.note.en: počúvam, počúvaš, počúva… The music is the object, so hudba becomes hudb**u**.
u5-mam-rad.pocuvat-hudbu.note.t: počúvam, počúvaš, počúva… Musiqa — toʻldiruvchi (nimani tinglaysiz?), shuning uchun hudba oʻrniga hudb**u** keladi.

u5-mam-rad.tancovat-a-spievat.note.en: Tancovať goes like študovať: tancuj**em**. Spievať: spievam. And **plávať** = to swim: plávam.
u5-mam-rad.tancovat-a-spievat.note.t: Tancovať študovať kabi tuslanadi: tancuj**em**. Spievať: spievam. Yana **plávať** = suzmoq: plávam.

en: You know **mať rád** from Akú farbu máš rada?: rád for a man, rada for a woman, and **radi** for a group. What you like is the object: Mám rád hudb**u**.
To like doing something, put rád with the verb alone, without mať: **Rád** hrám futbal. = I like playing football.
t: **mať rád** sizga Akú farbu máš rada? savolidan tanish: erkak uchun rád, ayol uchun rada, guruh uchun **radi**. Yoqtirgan narsangiz — toʻldiruvchi: Mám rád hudb**u**.
Biror ishni qilishni yoqtirsangiz, mať tushib qoladi va rád toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri feʼl bilan keladi: **Rád** hrám futbal. = Futbol oʻynashni yoqtiraman.

u5-mam-rad.fill-lucia-ma-rada.why.en: Rád changes with the person who likes: Lucia is a woman, so **rada**. Rád is for a man.
u5-mam-rad.fill-lucia-ma-rada.why.t: Rád yoqtirayotgan odamga qarab oʻzgaradi: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun **rada**. Rád — erkak uchun.

u5-mam-rad.fill-tomas-rad-hra.why.en: Tomáš is **on**, so the verb has no ending: **hrá**. Hrám is ja, hrajú is oni.
u5-mam-rad.fill-tomas-rad-hra.why.t: Tomash — **on** (u), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **hrá**. Hrám — ja, hrajú — oni shakli.

u5-mam-rad.choice-rada-tancujem.question.en: How does Emma say “I like dancing”?
u5-mam-rad.choice-rada-tancujem.question.t: Emma «Raqsga tushishni yoqtiraman» deb qanday aytadi?

u5-mam-rad.choice-rada-tancujem.why.en: To like doing something, rád goes with the verb alone, without mám. Emma is a woman, so it's **rada** tancujem.
u5-mam-rad.choice-rada-tancujem.why.t: Biror ishni qilishni yoqtirganda mám tushib qoladi va rád toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri feʼl bilan keladi. Emma — ayol, shuning uchun **rada** tancujem.

u5-mam-rad.build-mas-rad-futbal.prompt.en: Do you like football? (to a male friend)

en: You're asking a man, so it's **rád**. You'd ask a woman: Máš rada futbal?
You're asking a friend, **ty**, so mať is **máš**. Mám is the ja form, I have.
t: Siz erkakdan soʻrayapsiz, shuning uchun **rád**. Ayoldan esa shunday soʻraladi: Máš rada futbal?
Siz doʻstdan soʻrayapsiz, yaʼni **ty** (sen), shuning uchun mať — **máš**. Mám — ja shakli, «menda bor».

u5-mam-rad.grammar-paci-sa-mi.title.en: Páči sa mi: I like it

en: For what you see or hear, Slovak often says **Páči sa mi** (it pleases me). The thing you like is the subject: Páči sa mi tvoj sveter. For more than one thing: **Páčia** sa mi.
Say no with ne-: **Nepáči** sa mi. To ask a friend: Páči sa **ti**…?
t: Koʻrgan yoki eshitgan narsangiz haqida slovaklar koʻpincha **Páči sa mi** (menga yoqadi) deydi. Bu oʻzbekchadagi «menga yoqadi» kabi tuzilgan: yoqqan narsa — ega. Páči sa mi tvoj sveter. Bir nechta narsa uchun: **Páčia** sa mi.
Inkor ne- bilan yasaladi: **Nepáči** sa mi. Doʻstdan soʻrash uchun: Páči sa **ti**…?

u5-mam-rad.fill-paci-sa-mi-tvoje.why.en: The thing you like is the subject. Tričko is one thing, so it's **páči**; páčia is for more than one.
u5-mam-rad.fill-paci-sa-mi-tvoje.why.t: Yoqqan narsa — ega, oʻzbekchadagi «futbolkang yoqadi» kabi. Tričko — bitta narsa, shuning uchun **páči**; páčia bir nechta narsa uchun.

en: Emma likes swimming and listening to music.
Emma likes to swim and listen to music.
t: Emma suzishni va musiqa tinglashni yoqtiradi.
Emma suzish va musiqa tinglashni yoqtiradi.
Emma suzishni va musiqa tinglashni yaxshi koʻradi.

en: ísť (to go) is irregular, so learn it by heart.

Three prepositions often follow it, and they take the accusative. **na** = to (an event): Idem na oslav**u**. **po** = to go and get: Idem po chlieb. **cez** = through: Idem cez park (through the park).
t: ísť (bormoq) qoidaga boʻysunmaydi, shuning uchun uni yod oling.

Undan keyin koʻpincha uchta predlog keladi, ular akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) talab qiladi. **na** = …ga (tadbirga): Idem na oslav**u**. **po** = …ni olib kelishga: Idem po chlieb (nonga boryapman). **cez** = orqali: Idem cez park (park orqali).

en: Tomáš is going to get the wine.

u5-l5.fill-kam-ides-emma.why.en: The question is to Emma, **ty**, so ísť ends in **-eš**: ideš. Idem goes with ja, ide with on or ona.
u5-l5.fill-kam-ides-emma.why.t: Savol Emmaga berilyapti (ty), shuning uchun ísť **-eš** bilan tugaydi: ideš (boryapsan). Idem ja bilan, ide esa on yoki ona bilan keladi.

u5-l5.grammar-want-can-must.title.t: Xohlamoq, qila olmoq, majbur boʻlmoq + infinitív

en: chcieť (to want), môcť (can) and musieť (must, have to) are followed by an infinitive, the -ť form: ísť, kúpiť, piť (to drink).
Say no with ne-: nechcem, nemôžem, nemusím (I don't have to).
t: chcieť (xohlamoq), môcť (qila olmoq) va musieť (majbur boʻlmoq, kerak) feʼllaridan keyin infinitív keladi, yaʼni -ť bilan tugaydigan shakl (oʻzbekcha -moq kabi): ísť, kúpiť, piť (ichmoq).
Inkor ne- bilan yasaladi: nechcem, nemôžem, nemusím (shart emas).

en: What do you want to drink?

u5-l5.fill-lucia-a-marek.en.en: Lucia and Marek are going to the party.

u5-l5.fill-lucia-a-marek.why.en: Lucia and Marek are two people, **oni**, so ísť takes the oni form: **idú**. Ide is for one person, idete for vy.
u5-l5.fill-lucia-a-marek.why.t: Lusiya va Marek — ikki kishi, **oni**, shuning uchun ísť oni shaklida keladi: **idú**. Ide bitta kishi, idete esa vy uchun.

u5-l5.fill-musim-ist-ahoj.why.en: The speaker is **ja**, so musieť takes the ja form **musím**, followed by the infinitive ísť. Musia is for oni; môže means he or she can.
u5-l5.fill-musim-ist-ahoj.why.t: Gapiruvchi — **ja**, shuning uchun musieť ja shaklida: **musím**, undan keyin esa infinitív ísť keladi. Musia oni uchun, môže esa «u qila oladi» degani.

en: Môcť (can) is followed by an infinitive, the -ť form: môžeš **kúpiť**. Kúpim is the ja form, I'll buy.
The question is to **ty** (you), so môcť takes the ty form **môžeš**. Môžem is for ja, I can.
t: Môcť (qila olmoq) feʼlidan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť bilan tugaydigan shakl keladi: môžeš **kúpiť**. Kúpim — ja shakli, «sotib olaman».
Savol «sen»ga berilyapti, shuning uchun môcť ty shaklida keladi: **môžeš** (ola olasan). Môžem — ja uchun, «qila olaman».

en: **Na** (to an event) takes the accusative, so feminine oslava changes -a to **-u**: na **oslavu**.
“We” is **my**, so ísť takes the my form **ideme**. Idete is for vy.
t: Tadbirga borish **na** + akuzatív bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun oslava soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: na **oslavu** (bazmga).
«Biz» — **my**, shuning uchun ísť my shaklida keladi: **ideme** (boryapmiz). Idete vy uchun.

u5-l5.listen-idem-po-chlieb.en.en: I'm going to get bread and wine.
u5-l5.listen-idem-po-chlieb.en.t: Non va vino olib kelishga boryapman.

u5-l5.build-co-chces-pit.prompt.en: What do you want to drink?

en: The question is to **ty** (you), so chcieť takes the ty form **chceš**. Chcem is the ja form, I want.
To drink is **piť**; kúpiť means to buy. Both are infinitives, the -ť form that follows chcieť.
t: Savol «sen»ga berilyapti, shuning uchun chcieť ty shaklida keladi: **chceš**. Chcem — ja shakli, «xohlayman».
«Ichmoq» — **piť**, kúpiť esa «sotib olmoq». Ikkalasi ham infinitív, yaʼni chcieť feʼlidan keyin keladigan -ť shakli.

en: **smieť** = to be allowed to. Careful: nesmieš = you mustn't, but nemusíš = you don't have to.
**vedieť** + infinitive = to know how to: Viem variť. = I can cook.
t: **smieť** = ruxsat boʻlmoq, mumkin boʻlmoq. Ehtiyot boʻling: nesmieš = mumkin emas (taqiqlangan), nemusíš esa = shart emas.
**vedieť** + infinitív = biror ishni qilishni bilmoq: Viem variť. = Men ovqat pishirishni bilaman.

u5-l5.choice-viem-varit.why.en: **Vedieť** + infinitive means to know how to do something: viem variť = I can cook. I want to would be chcem, I have to musím.
u5-l5.choice-viem-varit.why.t: **Vedieť** + infinitív — biror ishni qilishni bilmoq: viem variť = ovqat pishirishni bilaman. «Xohlayman» chcem, «majburman» esa musím boʻlardi.

en: Not allowed is **nesmieť**: **nesmieš** = you mustn't. Careful: nemusíš means you don't have to.
You mustn't is **nesmieš**, smieť (to be allowed to) with ne-. Chceš means you want.
t: «Mumkin emas» — **nesmieť**: **nesmieš** = senga mumkin emas. Ehtiyot boʻling: nemusíš «shart emas» degani.
«Mumkin emas» — **nesmieš**, yaʼni ne- bilan smieť (ruxsat boʻlmoq). Chceš esa «xohlaysan» degani.

en: You do not have to go.

u5-l5.fill-ideme-cez-park.why.en: Going through a place is **cez** + accusative: ideme cez park. **Na** is for going to an event, like na oslavu.
u5-l5.fill-ideme-cez-park.why.t: Biror joy orqali oʻtish — **cez** + akuzatív: ideme cez park. **Na** esa tadbirga borish uchun, masalan na oslavu.

u5-l6.vsetko-najlepsie.en.t: Tugʻilgan kuning bilan! / Eng ezgu tilaklar!

u5-l6.vsetko-najlepsie.note.en: The standard wish for birthdays and name days.
u5-l6.vsetko-najlepsie.note.t: Tugʻilgan kun va ism kuni uchun odatiy tabrik (Slovakiyada har bir ismning kalendarda oʻz kuni bor).

u5-l6.choice-vsetko-najlepsie.question.en: It's your friend's birthday. What do you say?

u5-l6.torta-a-sviecky.note.en: One candle is sviečka. Plural things don't change as objects: Kúpime sviečky.
u5-l6.torta-a-sviecky.note.t: Bitta sham — sviečka. Koʻplikdagi narsalar akuzatívda (tushum kelishigida) oʻzgarmaydi: Kúpime sviečky.

u5-l6.kytica.note.en: Kúpime kytic**u**. = We'll buy a bouquet.

u5-l6.fill-kupime-tortu-a.en.en: We'll buy a cake and candles.

u5-l6.fill-kupime-tortu-a.why.en: The cake is what we'll buy, the object, so torta changes -a to **-u**: **tortu**. Sviečky is plural, and plural things don't change as objects.
u5-l6.fill-kupime-tortu-a.why.t: Tort — sotib olinadigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun torta soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: **tortu**. Sviečky — koʻplik, koʻplikdagi narsalar esa toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda oʻzgarmaydi.

u5-l6.vela-zdravia-stastia.en.en: Lots of health, happiness and love!

u5-l6.vela-zdravia-stastia.note.en: A classic birthday wish, often added after “Všetko najlepšie!”.
u5-l6.vela-zdravia-stastia.note.t: Tugʻilgan kunda aytiladigan anʼanaviy tilak, koʻpincha «Všetko najlepšie!» dan keyin qoʻshiladi.

en: After a preposition like **pre**, pronouns use their long forms: pre **teba**. Ťa is the short form, used without a preposition: hľadám ťa.
The present is one thing, so use the singular **darček**, which also fits je. Darčeky is the plural, presents.
t: **Pre** kabi predlogdan keyin olmoshlarning uzun shakli keladi: pre **teba** (sen uchun). Ťa — qisqa shakl, predlogsiz ishlatiladi: hľadám ťa.
Sovgʻa — bitta narsa, shuning uchun birlikdagi **darček** keladi, u je soʻziga ham mos. Darčeky — koʻplik, «sovgʻalar».

u5-l6.dakujem-za-darcek.note.en: ďakovať za + accusative: Ďakujem za kytic**u**.
u5-l6.dakujem-za-darcek.note.t: ďakovať za + akuzatív (tushum kelishigi) = …uchun rahmat aytmoq: Ďakujem za kytic**u**.

u5-l6.fill-dakujem-za-kyticu.why.en: **Ďakovať za** takes the accusative, so kytica changes -a to **-u**: za **kyticu**.
u5-l6.fill-dakujem-za-kyticu.why.t: **Ďakovať za** (… uchun rahmat aytmoq) akuzatív talab qiladi, shuning uchun kytica soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: za **kyticu**.

u5-l6.kedy-prides-o.en.en: When are you coming? — In an hour.

u5-l6.kedy-prides-o.note.en: prísť (to come) works like ísť: prídem, prídeš, príde… o + accusative: o hodin**u** = in an hour.
u5-l6.kedy-prides-o.note.t: prísť (kelmoq) ísť kabi tuslanadi: prídem, prídeš, príde… o + akuzatív (tushum kelishigi): o hodin**u** = bir soatdan keyin.

u5-l6.fill-tomas-pride-o.en.en: Tomáš is coming in an hour.

u5-l6.fill-tomas-pride-o.why.en: Tomáš is **on**, so prísť takes the on form, **príde**, just like ide. Prídem goes with ja, prídu with oni.
u5-l6.fill-tomas-pride-o.why.t: Tomash — **on**, shuning uchun prísť on shaklida keladi: **príde**, xuddi ide kabi. Prídem ja bilan, prídu esa oni bilan keladi.

en: I can't come, I have to work.
I cannot come, I have to work.
I can't come, I must work.

u5-l6.choice-na-zdravie.question.en: Marek raises his glass. What does he mean?
u5-l6.choice-na-zdravie.question.t: Marek qadahini koʻtaradi. U nima demoqchi?

u5-l6.build-kupim-kyticu-pre.prompt.en: I'll buy a bouquet for Lucia.

en: The bouquet is what you'll buy, the object of kúpim, so feminine kytica changes -a to **-u**: **kyticu**.
**Pre** (for) takes the accusative, and Lucia follows the feminine -u rule: Lucia → **Luciu**.
t: Guldasta — siz sotib oladigan narsa, kúpim feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun kytica soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: **kyticu**.
Oʻzbekchada «uchun»dan oldin ism oʻzgarmaydi, slovakchada esa **pre** (uchun) akuzatív talab qiladi: Lucia → **Luciu**.

u5-l7.fill-lucia-potrebuje-novu.why.en: Sukňu is a feminine object of potrebuje, so its adjective changes -á to **-ú**: nová → **novú**. Nový is the masculine form.
u5-l7.fill-lucia-potrebuje-novu.why.t: Sukňu — potrebuje feʼlining ayol jinsidagi toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun sifatda -á oʻrniga **-ú** keladi: nová → **novú**. Nový — erkak jinsi shakli.

u5-l7.listen-kupim-cerstvu-sunku.en.en: I'll buy fresh ham and cheese.
u5-l7.listen-kupim-cerstvu-sunku.en.t: Yangi vetchina va pishloq sotib olaman.

u5-l7.fill-emma-hlada-bielu.en.en: Emma is looking for a white shirt.

u5-l7.fill-emma-hlada-bielu.why.en: Košeľu is a feminine object, so the colour changes too. Biely has short endings: biela → **bielu**, with -u, not -ú.
u5-l7.fill-emma-hlada-bielu.why.t: Košeľu — ayol jinsidagi toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun rang ham oʻzgaradi. Biely qisqa qoʻshimchalar oladi: biela → **bielu**, -ú emas, -u bilan.

en: Marek is a person and the object of hľadám, so the masculine name adds **-a**: **Mareka**. Only masculine things stay the same.
The speaker is **ja** (I'm looking), so hľadať ends in **-m**: **hľadám**. Hľadáš is the ty form.
t: Marek — odam va hľadám feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi (oʻzbekchada «Marekni»), shuning uchun erkak ismi **-a** oladi: **Mareka**. Faqat erkak jinsidagi narsalar oʻzgarmaydi.
Gapiruvchi — **ja** (qidiryapman), shuning uchun hľadať **-m** bilan tugaydi: **hľadám**. Hľadáš — ty shakli.

u5-l7.choice-mam-noveho-kamarata.why.en: Kamarát is a male person, so as an object both words change: the noun adds **-a** and its adjective ends in **-ého**: nov**ého** kamarát**a**.
u5-l7.choice-mam-noveho-kamarata.why.t: Kamarát — erkak kishi, shuning uchun toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda ikkala soʻz ham oʻzgaradi: ot **-a**, sifat esa **-ého** oladi: nov**ého** kamarát**a**.

u5-l7.fill-tomas-cakam-na.why.en: After a preposition like **na**, on uses its long form: na **neho**. Ho is the short form, used without a preposition; ňu means her.
u5-l7.fill-tomas-cakam-na.why.t: **na** kabi predlogdan keyin on uzun shaklda keladi: na **neho**. Ho — predlogsiz ishlatiladigan qisqa shakl, ňu esa «uni» (ayolni).

en: After a preposition like **pre**, ona uses its long form: pre **ňu**. Ju is the short form, used without a preposition.
Here the bouquet isn't an object: the sentence is about it (kytica je…), so it keeps its plain form **kytica**. Kyticu is the object form.
t: **Pre** kabi predlogdan keyin ona uzun shaklda keladi: pre **ňu** (u uchun). Ju — qisqa shakl, predlogsiz ishlatiladi.
Bu yerda guldasta — gapning egasi (kytica je…), toʻldiruvchi emas, shuning uchun asosiy shakl qoladi: **kytica**. Kyticu — toʻldiruvchi shakli, «guldastani».

u5-l7.fill-oni-idu-na.why.en: With **oni** (they), ísť ends in **-ú**: idú. Ide goes with on or ona, idem with ja.
u5-l7.fill-oni-idu-na.why.t: **oni** (ular) bilan ísť **-ú** bilan tugaydi: idú. Ide on yoki ona bilan, idem esa ja bilan keladi.

en: Are you going to the party?

u5-l7.choice-ides-na-oslavu.why.en: **Ideš** is the ty form of ísť (to go), and **na** + accusative means going to an event: na oslavu = to the party.
u5-l7.choice-ides-na-oslavu.why.t: **Ideš** — ísť (bormoq) feʼlining ty shakli, **na** + akuzatív esa tadbirga borishni bildiradi: na oslavu = bazmga.

en: The cake is what you'd buy, the object of kúpiť, so feminine torta changes -a to **-u**: **tortu**.
Can you is **môžeš**, the ty form of môcť (can). Musíš means you must, from musieť.
t: Tort — siz sotib oladigan narsa, kúpiť feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun torta soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: **tortu**.
«Ola olasanmi?» — **môžeš**, môcť (qila olmoq) feʼlining ty shakli. Musíš esa musieť feʼlidan, «majbursan» degani.

u5-l7.fill-tu-nesmiete-fajcit.en.en: You're not allowed to smoke here.

u5-l7.fill-tu-nesmiete-fajcit.why.en: Not allowed is **nesmieť**: nesmiete = you mustn't. Careful: nemusíte means you don't have to, and neviete you don't know how.
u5-l7.fill-tu-nesmiete-fajcit.why.t: «Mumkin emas» — **nesmieť**: nesmiete = mumkin emas (taqiqlangan). Ehtiyot boʻling: nemusíte «shart emas», neviete esa «qila olmaysiz (bilmaysiz)» degani.

u5-l7.speak-pozyvam-ta-na.en.en: I'm inviting you to the party.
